name: French C1 - Upper Conversation Course
description: In this module, students will increase their knowledge of French as a foreign language, enabling them, both orally and in writing, to deal appropriately (act and react) with topics from day-to-day life, work and the culture of French-speaking regions. Using texts, current news articles, and excerpts from radio and televison programs, they will engage with the socio-cultural context of current issues. Topics suggested by students for examination are welcome. Knowledge in these areas will be increased and elements of grammar will be reviewed and fine-tuned. Students must independently prepare and deliver a short presentation on a cultural, social or scientific topic connected with France and then answer questions afterward.
prerequisites: Sound knowledge of level B2; placement test result C1
